posts.t:
Mackenzie Blackwood made a massive glove save on the opening shift on Guentzel to keep this game scoreless...for about 30 more seconds.

Vintage Avalanche rush. MacKinnon to Necas to Toews and it's 1-0.

Logan O’Connor is on the ice this morning for the Avs. He’s on LTIR and can’t return until after the upcoming two-game road trip. 

Jaden Schwartz is in a PP1 jersey, while Martin Necas is in a PP2 sweater.
